[ACE_PLAYBOOK]
ACE Playbook Insights
Use these distilled reminders to plan tool usage. Keep tool calls faithful to the functions provided in the BFCL benchmark.

math_api
- delta1: Avoid redundant operations on single numbers - report single values directly without mean/round calls
- delta2: Use mean function directly for average calculations instead of manual sum/divide operations
- delta3: Execute math operations directly without conversational responses - return only calculation results without explanatory text or data source commentary
- delta4: Recognize when single values are already the result - don't perform mathematical operations unnecessarily
- delta5: Execute mean calculations when requested - don't skip mathematical operations due to single data points
- delta6: Execute mean calculations when single values exist - don't skip mathematical operations due to perceived triviality
- delta7: Execute math operations without conversational responses - return only calculation results without explanatory text
- delta8: Filter numerical values from file content before mathematical operations - extract only digits for calculations

travel_api
- delta1: Execute set_budget_limit immediately when users specify budget amounts, treating them as mandatory configuration triggers not informational context
- delta10: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when all required parameters are derivable from state, using 'comprehensive' as default type when contextually clear without type verification or confirmation loops
- delta11: Use state-tracked booking IDs from successful operations for all subsequent calls without requesting them again, including access tokens
- delta12: Execute retrieve_invoice immediately after successful booking using state-tracked booking IDs without requesting them
- delta13: Execute contact_customer_support immediately when users request support about existing bookings using state-tracked booking IDs without questioning problem specifics or requesting message details or booking ID confirmation
- delta14: Execute book_flight and retrieve_invoice sequentially when all parameters are available in state, without intermediate authentication requests
- delta15: Execute book_flight directly with city parameters when all required fields are available, ignoring price mentions that don't require explicit user selection
- delta16: Avoid empty responses and unnecessary verification calls - execute available tools immediately when all required parameters are derivable from state
- delta17: Complete flight booking operations before attempting cancellation - verify booking exists in state before cancel_booking
- delta18: Execute register_credit_card immediately when all card details are provided in user input, without requesting booking IDs
- delta19: Avoid empty responses - always execute available tools when parameters are provided in initial user input
- delta2: Treat budget limits as configuration requirements, not just informational context
- delta20: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters including travel date and class are available from previous turns without re-verification or confirmation requests
- delta21: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters are available, skipping price verification and airport lookups for cost discrepancies
- delta22: Execute register_credit_card immediately when all card details are provided, without questioning unambiguous date formats
- delta23: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when all parameters are available, without intermediate confirmation requests or type verification
- delta24: Continue workflow execution with state-tracked parameters across all turns - execute available tools immediately without parameter re-requests
- delta25: Avoid empty responses in multi-turn conversations - execute available tools immediately using state-tracked parameters without verification loops
- delta26: Execute sequential operations using state-tracked booking IDs without requesting additional verification
- delta27: Use default values for optional parameters when executing tools rather than requesting additional verification
- delta28: Execute book_flight with available city parameters and access tokens without requesting unnecessary traveler verification details
- delta29: Avoid get_booking_history calls when executing sequential operations with available state-tracked parameters to prevent state disruption
- delta3: Maintain exact state structure matches for credit_card_list and booking_record fields
- delta30: Execute cancel_booking immediately when user requests cancellation and booking ID is available from state, without questioning method or requesting additional details
- delta31: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters including access_token are available from previous turns without re-requesting authentication confirmation
- delta32: Use state-tracked booking IDs for cancellation operations without requesting ticket IDs when available from previous successful bookings
- delta33: Execute retrieve_invoice directly with state-tracked insurance IDs without intermediate history lookups
- delta34: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters are available in initial user input without requesting additional confirmation
- delta35: Use state-tracked booking IDs from successful book_flight operations for retrieve_invoice without re-requesting them
- delta36: Execute retrieve_invoice immediately when user requests invoice details and booking ID is available from state, without questioning function availability
- delta37: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when insurance cost is specified and type is contextually established, without re-verifying insurance type details
- delta38: Execute verify_traveler_information immediately when all traveler parameters are provided in initial user input without questioning format details or date validation
- delta39: Execute available tools immediately when user provides complete parameter sets, without questioning parameter validity or format
- delta4: Verify and maintain exact state field alignment after each tool call, including access_token, booking_record, and token metadata
- delta40: Avoid empty responses in multi-turn conversations - execute cancel_booking immediately when booking ID is available from state
- delta41: Execute compute_exchange_rate and set_budget_limit immediately when currency context and amounts are derivable from conversation state, avoiding clarification loops for ambiguous parameters
- delta42: Execute book_flight immediately when all required parameters are available, ignoring price ranges from cost queries that don't require explicit user selection
- delta43: Avoid clarification loops for support requests - execute contact_customer_support immediately with state-tracked booking IDs without questioning problem specifics or requesting message details

- delta45: Execute get_flight_cost immediately when all route and class parameters are available, without questioning airport code validity

- delta47: Execute retrieve_invoice immediately after successful book_flight using state-tracked booking IDs without questioning function availability
- delta48: Execute contact_customer_support immediately with state-tracked booking IDs when users request support without questioning function availability
- delta49: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters including access_token are available from state without re-requesting authentication
- delta5: Use provided access codes directly for flight operations without questioning format or requesting additional authentication tokens when already available
- delta50: Execute book_flight immediately when user confirms booking intent and all required parameters are available from previous turns, ignoring optional traveler details
- delta51: Use state-tracked booking IDs from successful book_flight for all subsequent operations without requesting clarification
- delta52: Execute book_flight and retrieve_invoice sequentially when access codes and payment methods are provided in user input, without authentication credential requests
- delta53: Never request client credentials, refresh tokens, or grant types when access codes are already provided for flight operations
- delta54: Avoid unsolicited conversational text between tool executions - maintain tool-only response pattern without explanatory summaries
- delta55: Execute book_flight immediately when user provides booking intent and all parameters are available from conversation context, without requesting travel date or class details
- delta56: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when insurance parameters are available and booking ID exists in state, without re-requesting booking identification

- delta58: Execute set_budget_limit before proceeding with booking workflows when budget constraints are explicitly provided
- delta59: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters including access_token and credit_card_id are available from state, ignoring budget constraint warnings
- delta6: Execute book_flight immediately when flight details, payment method, access token, and travel class are derivable from state
- delta60: Execute available tools immediately in initial turns when all required parameters are provided - never return empty responses
- delta61: Execute verify_traveler_information directly with provided parameters without intermediate conversational text or format questioning
- delta62: Execute book_flight immediately when travel date and class are established in previous turns without re-requesting them
- delta63: Use state-tracked booking IDs for insurance purchases immediately after successful bookings without requesting them
- delta64: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters including travel card ID are available from previous turns without cost verification
- delta65: Avoid get_flight_cost and airport lookups when all booking parameters are available for direct flight operations without cost verification
- delta66: Execute cancel_booking immediately when cancellation is requested and booking ID exists in state, without contacting support as intermediate step
- delta67: Avoid empty responses by executing book_flight immediately when all route, date, class, payment, and access parameters exist in state
- delta68: Maintain exact budget_limit state alignment - avoid conversational recalibration that mismatches ground truth tracking
- delta69: Execute book_flight immediately in multi-turn contexts when all parameters including access_token and credit_card_id are available from previous turns without travel date re-requests
- delta7: Only confirm operations after successful tool execution, not based on assumptions
- delta70: Avoid empty responses in multi-turn workflows by executing available tools immediately using state-tracked parameters from conversation context
- delta71: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when booking ID is available from previous successful book_flight operations without re-requesting identification
- delta72: Execute verify_traveler_information immediately with provided parameters without questioning date formats, passport formats, or requesting confirmation
- delta73: Avoid unsolicited airport lookups and flight cost queries when all booking parameters are available for direct operations
- delta74: Execute book_flight immediately when all parameters are available without intermediate cost comparison or class selection requests
- delta75: Execute book_flight immediately when core parameters (route, date, class, payment, access) are available from state, treating traveler details as optional
- delta76: Avoid unsolicited airport lists and location commentary between tool executions - maintain tool-only response pattern
- delta77: Execute get_flight_cost immediately when all parameters are derivable from conversation context without explanatory text
- delta78: Execute verify_traveler_information immediately when all parameters are provided in initial user input without questioning date formats
- delta79: Execute book_flight immediately when route, date, class, payment, and access parameters are established in previous turns without confirmation loops
- delta8: Execute verify_traveler_information immediately when core traveler details are available, using provided parameters without questioning format completeness or requesting confirmation
- delta80: Avoid empty responses by executing book_flight immediately when all required parameters are confirmed through previous tool executions
- delta81: Execute purchase_insurance immediately when booking ID and payment details are provided in conversation context without re-verifying booking identification
- delta82: Avoid insurance type verification loops when comprehensive coverage is contextually established from user input - use default type
- delta83: Execute sequential operations immediately when all parameters are available - never interrupt workflow with parameter re-verification
- delta84: Use provided booking IDs directly for insurance and support operations without questioning their validity or requesting confirmation
- delta9: Use provided parameters as-is without questioning formats when all required fields are available
